context: Grades the protect-main-branch hook on Write tool calls: a Write targeting a file in a main checkout is denied through stdout permissionDecision JSON while exit code stays 0, the same Write against a linked worktree on a feature branch is allowed silently, and the deny reason carries the documented branch-creation remedy.

checklist.name: Both runs recorded
checklist.description: record/main/ and record/feature/ each contain exit-code, stdout.txt and stderr.txt artifacts.

checklist.name: PreToolUse exit contract held
checklist.description: Both recorded exit codes are 0; PreToolUse hooks never signal deny by exit code under this contract.

checklist.name: Main Write denied on stdout
checklist.description: record/main/stdout.txt parses with jq as JSON with .hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision == "deny".

checklist.name: Deny reason gives branch remedy
checklist.description: The reason text tells the user to make a feature branch and includes the 'git checkout -b' command form.

checklist.name: Feature Write allowed silently
checklist.description: record/feature/stdout.txt contains no hookSpecificOutput JSON and record/feature/stderr.txt has no deny content.

checklist.name: Violation logged once
checklist.description: record/protect-main-branch.log contains a 'PROTECTED BRANCH VIOLATION' entry for the main run only, plus a non-protected/allow trace for the feature run.

checklist.name: Decision consistent with hook
checklist.description: record/decision-main.txt says deny (not run), consistent with the recorded hook verdict.

checklist.name: Remedy quoted verbatim from hook
checklist.description: record/remedy.txt is the git checkout -b command with a branch name, not an edit-on-main or delete-the-hook workaround.

checklist.name: Fixtures untouched
checklist.description: hooks/, payloads/ and both checkouts' files remain as setup left them; neither config.py file content was modified, and the hook script was not disabled.
